content:
**Exterminator** is a Perception-based perk in *Fallout 76*.

Reduces the Damage Resistance of insects and mirelurks.

| Rank | Cost | Description | Form ID | 
| ★★★ | 3 | Your attacks ignore 75% armor of any insect. | 0032DA6D | 
| ★★ | 2 | Your attacks ignore 50% armor of any insect. | 0032DA6C | 
| ★ | 1 | Your attacks ignore 25% armor of any insect. | 0032CB42 | 

Despite the perk's description not explicitly stating it, the perk also ignores the armor of mirelurks.

 The perk reduces only Damage Resistance and does not reduce other elemental resistances. [verified]
